summary_en: Tender offer price increased to ¥3,450 per share from ¥3,000. Offer period extended to 2026-08-03 (58 business days total). Change prompted by competing proposal from Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo disclosed 2026-07-01, and sustained market trading above ¥3,000.
title_en: Notice regarding changes to terms and conditions of public tender offer for shares and warrants of Kakaku.com, Inc. (TSE Code 2371) by Kamgras 1 KK
translation_en_brief: Kamgras 1 KK, a consortium entity, announced on 2026-07-17 that it is raising the tender offer price for Kakaku.com shares from ¥3,000 to ¥3,450 per share. The original offer launched 2026-05-13. The price increase follows a competing binding proposal submitted by Bain Capital and LINE Yahoo on 2026-07-01 targeting the same company (also involving a take-private via squeeze-out). Since that disclosure, the company's market price has traded above the original ¥3,000 offer level, and the consortium cited sustained market trading, shareholder participation trends, and a request from Kakaku.com's board for price negotiation as grounds for the raise. The consortium stated it believes ¥3,000 already reflected intrinsic value and a reasonable premium to the pre-offer close, but that a prolonged competing-bid environment would harm the target's operational clarity and corporate value. Concurrently, the tender offer period is being extended to 2026-08-03 (10 business days from the amendment filing date), bringing the total offer window to 58 business days.
